neighbours.label: The closing piece of a few rare multi-part words: 'ads' in microbeads, 'gression' in microaggression, 'ot' in Maginot, 'ora(s)' in amphora(s). A list; I found no shared pattern
fire: The factory stopped adding microbeads to its face wash.
Tiny microbeads wash down the drain and reach the sea.
Her essay calls that remark a microaggression and explains why.
A small microaggression can wear people down at work.
France spent heavily on the Maginot forts before the war.
Divers lifted a clay amphora from the old wreck.
Greek amphoras often carried wine and olive oil.
Historians still argue about the Maginot defenses.
quiet: The factory stopped adding perfume to its face wash.
Tiny plastic grains wash down the drain and reach the sea.
Her essay calls that remark an insult and explains why.
A small slight can wear people down at work.
France spent heavily on coastal forts before the war.
Divers lifted a clay pot from the old wreck.
Greek jars often carried wine and olive oil.
Historians still argue about the French defenses.

predictions: Holds, but as a small part of the pole.
notes: Kept as a list on purpose. The obvious generalisation, mid-word pieces of rare words, failed in probes: chrysanthemum, hippopotamus, onomatopoeia and cytokine all stayed under 0.03. The card's other peak tokens ('ي', German 'f' in An-f-) are not tested here, so coverage is probably low.
